emerging_technology: Generative AI language model used for document review; no autonomous external actions. Leading-edge general business use is a classroom premise, not an independently verified maturity rating.
intended_application: Assist university program staff to check syllabi against required elements, flag possible omissions and show supporting passages. Staff review every finding and retain final approval.
organization: Hypothetical university Program B with stronger operating preparation; not actual NYU operations.
business_need: Reduce syllabus-review effort without losing required-element coverage or accountable human approval.
users_stakeholders: Program administrators, faculty syllabus authors, program director, IT support and students indirectly affected by syllabus quality.
adoption_posture: Moderate fast follower; willing to consider a supervised evaluation once readiness conditions are met.
capabilities_constraints: STIPULATED CASE FACTS: Program director sponsors and authorizes preparation for a bounded evaluation; final live-trial approval remains a separate human decision. Approved environment, permitted syllabi and one authoritative versioned checklist are available. Program operations manager and a named-role deputy are assigned ownership, maintenance and handover; both have protected capacity. A mixed-experience reviewer group has completed supervised workflow practice, not an outcomes trial. The four-week evaluation has approved review/support time and spending coverage. A queue, escalation procedure, manual fallback, stop authority and outcome log are defined. Staff concerns have been recorded with a feedback meeting scheduled. The director will consider later resources, but recurring semester funding, peak-volume coverage and performance outcomes remain unverified.
risk_consequence_context: False negatives may miss required content; false positives and unsupported passages may waste staff time. No student grading, automatic syllabus approval, publication or autonomous actions. Human review and manual fallback remain required.
management_question: Can this organization implement and sustain AI-assisted syllabus checking, which readiness gap matters most, and what must change before a bounded evaluation?
time_horizon: Four-week preparation and evaluation planning; sustained operation considered separately over the following semester.
